title.narrative: Somalia Stability Fund Phase III

description.narrative:
The Danish support is part of the support provided through the Peace and Stabilisation Fund as part of the Peace and Stabilisation Programme for the Horn of Africa 2023-26 under its thematic priority on Political Stability – Outcome 1: “Political settlements in Somalia at federal, state and local level, in the Somali region of Ethiopia and targeted regional cross border areas are more inclusive and stable”.
SSF objective will directly contribute to Outcome 1 on political stability of the PSP HoA, i.e. Political settlements in Somalia at federal, state and local level, in the Somali region of Ethiopia and targeted regional cross border areas are more inclusive and stable.
With a more tightly defined political objective of the SSF III will prioritise work on political settlements, reconciliation and social contract (Output 1, 2 & 4 – see section below) at the federal level and across all states (and in-between where appropriate). Output 3 will work on Democratisation and local governance. Output 4 will focus on social contract and output 5 will be a research pillar.
